up: Retrieve the ChEMBL IDs, preferred names, and canonical SMILES for all compounds mentioned in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4513141'. Join the docs table to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures on molregno. Filter where docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513141'. Return only the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513141'
